items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 71:1
items.html:
Thickening in the posteriors
When the light of the face is first received in the vessels of the posteriors before its coming to its vessels of the face, the light is found to receive a phase of covering from the posteriors on its way through them, whereby the light thickens and diminishes, and does not illuminate at its full measure even after it comes into the vessels of the face. (p. 501, Item 24)
